I found no corresponding public acceptance of responsibility, apology, resignation, investigation commitment, or explicit acceptance of responsibility for protest deaths or security-force abuse.","evidence":[{"title":"We Will Transform Nigeria Police Into Modern, Professional Force – President Tinubu","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"April 16, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/we-will-transform-nigeria-police-into-modern-professional-force-president-tinubu/","summary":"Tinubu said his administration had begun reforms to make the police more modern, professional, accountable, and better trained. This is partial acknowledgment of harm, but it stops short of accepting responsibility for security-force abuses or policy failure.","question_ids":["2B.9","2B.5","2B.4","2B.6","1B.8"]},{"title":"At least 3 killed in Nigeria at protests over high cost of living","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"August 1, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hundreds-gather-across-nigerian-cities-to-protest-cost-of-living-crisis-3548376","summary":"Reuters reported at least three protesters were killed in Kaduna during the nationwide demonstrations. This is negative evidence because it shows lethal state violence occurred while the government was publicly defending its handling of the crisis.","question_ids":["2B.9","2B.5","2B.4","2B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #EndBadGovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"November 28, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty said police used excessive force during the August protests, killing at least 24 people and detaining more than 1,200. This is corroborating negative evidence: instead of accountability for abuse, the state escalated legally and rhetorically.","question_ids":["2B.9","2B.6","2B.5","2B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges 76, including minors, with treason after August protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"November 1, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nigeria-charges-76-including-minors-with-treason-after-august-protests-3698000","summary":"Reuters reported the government expanded treason charges to 76 people, including minors, after the August protests.
